Alignment.description: Motion correspondence used only for supplementary aligned measurements.

oneOf.description: Existing phase-correlation global translation, confidence at least 0.6.
Existing qualified dense image correspondence; requires dense-motion.

Capture.description: One externally captured observation on the common declared timeline.

image.description: Relative image path inside the plan directory.

timestamp_ms.description: Declared timestamp in milliseconds; never inferred from filenames.

Frame.description: Matched frame measurements and explicit alignment support.

aligned_error.description: Supplementary aligned error, null when no correspondence is supported.

aligned_pixels.description: Supported aligned pixels; geometric/flow exclusions are explicit.

aligned_regions.description: Supplementary aligned tile errors for temporal inspection.

raw_error.description: Raw error; correspondence never changes this score.

regions.description: Raw tiles exceeding the declared local/settling threshold.

residual_flicker.description:
Maximum tile signed-residual change from the previous frame, divided by two.
Null for the first frame or incomplete persistent correspondence support.

translation.description: Estimated dx,dy,confidence for translation; null in other modes.

Plan.description: Explicit capture lists, avoiding silent pairing or missing-frame truncation.

alignment.description: Alignment diagnostics do not override raw error budgets.

candidate.description: Candidate observations, in strictly increasing timestamp order.

id_buffers.description: Optional L8/L16 ID buffer per frame, on the original reference grid.

include_ids.description: IDs to include; combined with masks by intersection, never candidate-derived.

masks.description: Optional binary L8 inclusion mask per frame, on the original reference grid.

reference.description: Independent matched reference; required for animation and level pairs.

Region.description: Spatially localized error at one observation.

error.description: Scoped mean absolute normalized RGB difference.

TransitionPolicy.description: Declared transition budgets and observation windows.

change_frame.description: Switch request index; null selects a matched pair of steady levels.

consecutive.description: Number of consecutive observations required for convergence.

maximum_duration_ms.description: Maximum time from request to K settled frames, in milliseconds.

maximum_pop.description: Maximum positive frame-to-frame RGB error above motion baseline.

maximum_steady_error.description: Maximum final-window paired level difference, normalized RGB MAE.

settle_threshold.description: Maximum tile error for convergence to the target observation.

window.description: Final observation window length and pre-switch baseline window length.

description: Complete transition packet, separate from static geometry proof.

motion_baseline.description: Raw temporal motion baseline from the reference, or pre-switch window.

pop_curve.description: Positive excess over baseline, indexed by later frame; index zero is zero.

pop_frame.description: Earliest maximum in the switch interval; null if no positive excess.

popping.description: Maximum excess in the declared switch interval (null for level pairs).

settle_frame.description: First K-frame target-convergence interval; null for level pairs/unsettled.

steady_state_basis.description: matched_reference or pre_post_windows; single-sequence values include temporal motion.

steady_state_difference.description: Final-window paired level difference, or pre/post window difference for a single switch.

transition_duration_ms.description: Timestamp difference from request to settling; null if unmeasured.

title: TransitionReport
